question: Who among the following won the Men's Singles Paris Masters Titles in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Holger Rune.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Holger Vitus Nødskov Rune:-**

 
 
• **He is a Danish professional tennis player.**
 
• He has been ranked as high as world No. 4 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP), making him the highest-ranked male Danish player in the history of the ATP rankings.
 
• **Holger Rune won the Men's Singles Paris Masters title in 2022. He defeated the defending champion Novak Djokovic in the final, 3–6, 6–3, 7–5. **
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Carlos Alcaraz Garfia:-**

 
 
• **He is a Spanish professional tennis player. **
 
• He has been ranked as high as world No. 1 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP).
 
• Alcaraz has won twelve ATP Tour-level singles titles, including two major titles (at the 2022 US Open and 2023 Wimbledon Championships) and four Masters 1000 titles. 
 
 
 
• **Novak Djokovic:- **
 
 
• **He is a Serbian professional tennis player who is currently ranked world No. 1 in men's singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP). **
 
• He has held the top ranking for a record 390 weeks, and has finished the year as world No. 1 a record seven times.
 
 
 
• **Casper Ruud:-**
 
 
• **He is a professional tennis player from Norway. **
 
• He is noted for his powerful groundstrokes and strong baseline game.
